claims_not_supported: no GridSDF/GPU bridge qualification (analytic body only; that is W1g)
no sampled-sphere T4 run (that is W2-T4b)
no grid independence, absolute Cd, literature validation or W2b ladder
no v16 geometry behavior, gradient, topology or optimizer claim
claims_supported: the registered W2a analytic sphere fixture runs on the registered Colab T4 CUDA backend with mem=CuArray
the T4 analytic run reaches the registered horizon with finite fields and forces and a positive drag sign
the T4 analytic window-mean drag agrees with the CPU analytic fixture within the registered 1% bound
the T4 force evidence is repeatable and both arithmetic and physical-time-weighted means are recorded

affine_map.note: not used by the analytic fixture; recorded for the later W2-T4b sampled run

flow.boundary_conditions: uBC = (U,0,0), no periodic direction, exitBC disabled

fixture.geometry: WaterLily AutoBody with the exact analytic sphere SDF in solver coordinates (identical to the W2a analytic fixture)

time.time_weighted_mean: diagnostic: trapezoidal integral of the window samples, integral(F dt)/integral(dt) using actual sim_time

gates_registered_before_measurement.T0_environment: the W0b environment pair (Project e4b56407, Manifest c537ae8e) and T4 device identity are the registered ones
gates_registered_before_measurement.T1_completion: the T4 analytic run reaches t_end in tU/D units with steps > 0 and no exception
gates_registered_before_measurement.T2_finiteness: all(isfinite, u) and all(isfinite, p) at the end of the run
gates_registered_before_measurement.T3_force_finite: every sampled force component is finite
gates_registered_before_measurement.T6_cpu_t4_agreement: |drag_T4 - drag_W2a_cpu| / |drag_W2a_cpu| <= 0.01 (fixed before the T4 measurement; bitwise equality not required)
gates_registered_before_measurement.T7_repeatability: a second identical T4 run matches the first in window-mean drag within relative 1e-6
gates_registered_before_measurement.T8_runtime_and_vram: wall seconds, steps, ms/step, Julia threads and the polled peak CUDA used_memory are recorded, with 0 < peak VRAM < total device memory
gates_registered_before_measurement.threshold_modification_rule: no bound relaxation after seeing a measurement; a failure is a fail-closed stop with no evidence written

provenance.run_media: Colab T4 runtime driven through the colab-mcp browser connection; stdout captured into work/sdf_native_w2t4a_analytic_sphere_2026_09/

what_W2T4a_qualifies: the WaterLily analytic sphere primal on the T4/CUDA backend
force sign and finite/traceable force history on the registered fixture
CPU/T4 agreement of the analytic fixture within the registered bound
what_W2T4a_does_not_qualify: grid convergence or absolute aerodynamic values
